title: Finished the 10K at the Pisa Half Marathon
body: On 11 October I completed the 10K race at the 20th Pisa Half Marathon. Around the 7 km mark I was close to crashing out, but I pushed through to the finish. Medal collected.
imageAlt: Dolapo holding a finisher medal after the 10K at the Pisa Half Marathon, with the Leaning Tower in the background
